title: Forgotten Realm
description: An early stage project designated for an RPG themed modpack.
body:
An early stage project designated for an RPG themed minecraft modpack.

Long term, the project is planned to include a custom singleplayer or multiplayer compatible map. This would include custom built towns, NPCs, quests, and dungeons. The goal is to simulate a fantasy themed world on the verge of an industrial revolution. The "Forgotten Realm" signifying and underlying story arc that the player will go through.

Current Features :
- Seasons - Experience the 4 seasons via [Serene Seasons](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons)
- Combat - A shakeup of modern combat styles with [Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat)
- Bosses - Fight multiple challenging bosses, including mods but not limited to [L_Ender's Cataclysm](https://modrinth.com/mod/l_enders-cataclysm), and [Mowzie's Mobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/mowzies-mobs)
- Backpacks - Make looting and inventory management easier with [Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks)
- Furniture - Tons of furniture additions from [Macaw](https://modrinth.com/user/sketchmacaw)
- Archeology - Discover remnants of the past with [Better Archeology](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-archeology)
- Decoration Blocks - Get creative with [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped) and [FramedBlocks](https://modrinth.com/mod/framedblocks)
